headings.text: Mishlei Shelomo ben David Melek Yisrayl
Israyl Kumpi David’ Tapa Solomon’ Paunakte

verses.text: Israyl kumpi David’ tapa Solomon’ paunakte:
Mite in pilna leh gamtat hoih a ngah nading, khiatna thuk a nei kammalte a tel theih nading,
pilna, thutanna, thukhen siamna leh a kilawm a kituaka gamtat theihna cihte ngaihsut siam nadingin kisinna ngah nading,
mimawlte tungah ciimna a pia ding, khangnote tungah thutheihna leh ngaihsut siamna a pia ding,
(Mipilte in zong za-in, a thutheihna uh khang semsem henla, mi ciimsate in lamlahna hoih ngah uh hen);
lungsim puahphat nading leh paunakte, thugentehnate leh kidop dinga genkholhnate, mi ciimte’ thugennate leh a haksa thuthuk amau dotnate zatna tawh gamtat hoihna kisek nading ahi hi.
Yahweh zahtakna in pilna kipatna hi a, mihaite bek in pilna leh thuhilhna simmawh uh hi.
Ka ta aw, na pa hong thuhilhna ngai inla, na nu’ hong hilh torah nusia kei in;
Tuate in na lu tungah a hoih kizepna tawh kibang ding a, na ngawng-a a etlawm khi tawh kibang ding hi.
Ka ta aw, mi mawhte in hong zol ciangin amau’ zolna zui kei in.
Amaute in, “Hong pai in, mi khatpeuh sisan suah dingin va pang ni. Thu om lopi-in mawhbaang lo pawlkhat va buk ni.
Hankhuk bangin a hingin amaute nawmvalh-in, dum sunga kiate bangin va pumkhiat ni.
Tua hileh hauhna namkim i ngah ding a, i innte van ngahte tawh a dim ding hi.
Kote lakah hong kihel in; sumbawm i nei khawm ding hi,” hong cih uh ciangin,
Ka ta aw, amaute zui kei inla, amau lampi panin na khe kem in;
bang hang hiam cihleh sisan suah ding a manlang mah bangun amau khete siatna ah manlang uh hi.
Vasate muh tangpi-in thang siah le hang bang phattuamna om ahi hiam?
Ahih hangin hih mite in amau sisan luan nading mah ngak uh a, amau nuntakna mah a buksim uh hi!
Zawhthawh thu tawh mi’ na a sutte’ lampi tua bang hi a, tua banga a ngahte in a nuntakna suplawh uh hi.
Lampi ah nakpi-in pilna kiko a, kongzing lakah a aw a sangsak hi.
Khuapi kulh kongpi lutnate-a kulh tung dawnte ah hong kiko-in thugen a,

“No mimawlte aw, bang tanvei haina deih lai ding na hi uh hiam? No mi gensiate aw, bang tanvei mikona nuamsa lai ding na hi uh hiam? No mihaite aw, bang tanvei thutheihna mudah lai ding na hi uh hiam?
Kong taii-na leh kong hilhkholhna ah kikhel hi le uh cin, note tungah ka kha kong bua ding a, ka kammalte kong telsak ding hi.
Ahih hangin kong sap-a kipanin nong nial uh a, ka khut kong vaan lai-in kuamah in nong thudon loh nungsangun,
kong ngaihsut piakna khat beek zong ngaihsut-in nei loin, kong taii-na leh kong hilhkholhna khat zong na sang loh nungsangun—
Haksatna na tuah uh ciangin kei zong kong nuihsan lel ding a, no tungah a lipkhaphuai hong tun ciangin kong zahpih ding hi;
Huihpi bangin no tungah lauhuai-na hong tun ciang, pingpei bangin no tungah suksiatna hong tun ciang, no tungah lungkhamna leh sinkhamna hong tun ciangin kong nuihsan lel ding hi.
Tua ciangin amaute in kei hong sam ding uh a, ahih hangin ka dawng kei ding hi. Amaute in limtakin kei hong zong ding uh a, ahih hangin hong mu kei ding uh hi—
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in thu theihna mudah-in, Yahweh tungah zahtakna piak ding a teel nuam kei uh hi.
Amaute in ka ngaihsut piakna khat zong nei loin, ka taii-na leh ka hilhkholhna khempeuh a simmawh nungsangun,
amau gamtatna gah mah ne ding uh a, amau ngaihsutna tawh mawk om meimai ding uh hi.
Mimawlte in amau kihei khiatna sihlawh ding a, mi haite’ kihai muanna in amau kisiatna ding mah ahi hi.
Ahih hangin ka thu hong ngai peuhmah in suksiatna kihta loin muanhuai tak leh lungmuang takin om ding uh hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thugente na san a, ka Thukamte na sungah na khol leh;
pilna lamah na bil ngatin, thu theihtelna lamah na lungsim na zat leh;
Hi hi, thutheihna deih takpi-in, theihtel theihna lunggulhin nakpi-in na kiko leh;
Nangmah in ngun bangin pilna zongin, a kiseel van manpha zon bangin pilna na zon leh—
tua ciangin nangmah in Yahweh zahtakna thu na theitel ding a, i Vantung Pa’ theihna na mu ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh pilna a piapa Yahweh hi a, Ama kam panin theihna leh thu theihtelna hong pai hi.
Yahweh in thumaan mite aa dingin thu theihtel theihna hoih koihsak a, Amah pen thutang taka a gamta mite aa dingin kidalna lum ahi hi:
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh in thutang mite’ lampi cing a, Ama misiangte’ lampi a kem hi.
Tua hileh thumaan lampi peuhmah—thumaan, thutang leh a kilawm a kituak na thei ding hi.
Na lungsim sungah pilna hong lut ciangin thutheihna in na nuntakna hong nuamsak ding a—
Khentel siamna in nang hong hu-in, thu theihtelna in nang hong cing ding hi;
tua in siatna lampi pan, thulehgen mite kiang pan,
khuamial lampite a zui dingin thumaan lampi a nusia mite kiang pan,
siatna gamtat nuamsa-in, thusia kawigenna nuam a sa mite kiang pan,
a lampite uh kawi-in amau lampite mah in a lehkhem mite kiang panin hong hotkhiat theih nading ahi hi.
Khentel theihna leh thu theihtelna in theih ngeiloh numei pan leh, kam khum zangin mi a zol numei paktat kiang panin nang hong hon ding hi;
tua nu in a kikholpih a khangno lawm ama pasal nusia a, a Pa Yahweh’ thuciamna a mangngilh hi.
Sihna sungah tuanu’ inn tolhsuk a, ama lampite in sihna lam zuan hi.
Ama kiangah a pai peuhmah kilehkik nawn lo a, amaute in nuntakna lampite zong a tawn nawn kei uh hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thutang lampi tawn inla, thumaan lampite zui in;
Bang hang hiam cihleh thutang mite leitung ah teng ding uh a, a paubang lo mite a om ding uh hi.
Ahih hangin migilote ahih leh leitung panin kilawn khia ding a, leitung panin thupalsatte kizungbot ding hi.

headings.text: Yahweh in Pilna tawh Leitung Phut

verses.text: Ka ta aw, ka Thukham mangngilh kei inla, ka thuhilhnate zong na lungtang ah ciamteh in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh nuntak nite, khansau-na leh lungnopna, nang tungah hong kibehlap ding hi.
Hehpihna leh thu man kinusia sak ngei kei inla, na ngawng ah tuate awkin, na lungsim kawm tungah gelh in;
tua hileh, Yahweh leh mihingte muhna ah pahtawina, minphatna leh thukimpihna na ngah ding hi.
Na lungsim khempeuh tawh Yahweh muang inla, nangma theihna suang kei in.
Na hihna khempeuh ah Yahweh phawk in; tua ciangin Amah in lam hong lak ding hi.
Nang le nang pil kisa kei inla, siatna panin kihei sitsetna tawh Yahweh zahtak in.
Hih in na pumpi cidamsak ding a, na guhte thadimsak ding hi.
Na neihsate leh na ngahna khempeuh panin gah masate tawh Yahweh pahtawi in;
tua ciangin na ansalte ah tampitak dim ding a, na beelte leenggahzu thak tawh dimlet ding hi.
Ka ta aw, Yahweh’ hong thuhilhna thusim lo kei inla, Ama hong puahphatna sangnuam lo kei in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh pa in ama lungdamna ahi a tapa a puahphat mah bangin Yahweh in a it mite a puahpha hi.
Pilna a mu mipa, thupha ngah ahi hi. Thu theihtelna a ngah mipa, thupha ngah ahi hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua bang ngahna pen ngun ngahna sangin hoihzaw a, a thaman pen kham hoihpen sangin zong lianzaw hi.
Pilna in suangsan manpha pente sangin manpha zaw a, na lunggulhpente khat beek tawh tehkak theih ding ahi kei hi.
Khansau-na ama taklam khut sungah om a, ama veilam khut ah hauhna leh pahtawina a om hi.
Ama lampite pen lungdamna lampite hi a, ama zawi khempeuh lungnopna vive ahi hi.
Amah pen amah a pom mite aa dingin nuntakna singkung khat ahi hi. Amah a kiplet mite thupha ngah ahi hi.
Yahweh in pilna tawh leitung phut hi. Amah in theihtelna tawh vantungte kipsak hi.
Ama thutheihna tungtawntin a thukpite kitamzan a, vanpite in daitui a kiasak hi.
Ka ta aw, a kip pilna leh khensat siamna kemcing inla, na mai panin khahsuah ngei kei in.
Amaute pen na sunglam aa dingin nuntakna hi ding a, na ngawng-a kizepna hoih tawh kibang ding hi.
Tua ciangin na lampi ah lungmuang takin na pai ding aa, na khe in bangmah suikha lo ding hi.
Na lup ciangin na lau kei ding hi. Hi hi, na lumsuk ding a, na ihmut nuam mahmah ding hi.
Hong phawngvat lipkhaphuai lau-na na nei kei ding a, migilote kisuksiatna a tun ciangin zong na lau kei ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh Yahweh pen nangma kimuanna hi ding a, thang-a awk nading panin na khe hong kem ding hi.
Na huh zawh ding ahih leh, huhna kisam mi khatpeuh na huh nuam lo kei in.
Na neih hi-in, na kianga ompi mah ahih leh, na vengpa kiangah, “Ciah-in, zingciang hong paikik in, kong pia ding hi,” ci kei in.
Nang hong muangin na kianga hong teng na vengpa tungah siatna bawl kei in.
Nangma nat nading bangmah hong bawl lo ahih leh, thu om lopi-in mi khatpeuh mawhsak kei in.
Mi bawlsiate engkha kei inla, amau lampite zong teel kei in.
Lungkhauh mite Yahweh aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi; ahih hangin Ama thusim pen thumaan mite tawh om hi.
Migilote’ inn sungah Yahweh’ samsiatna om a, ahih hangin Amah in thutang mite’ inn thupha a pia hi.
Amah in mi en-neute zahpih taktak a, ahih hangin a kiniamkhiatte tungah pahtawina a pia hi.
Mipilte in minthanna luah ding uh a, ahih hangin mi haite in maizumna ngah ding uh hi.
Tate aw, na thu theihtelna uh a khan theih nadingin Yahweh hong thuhilhna limtakin don un.
Bang hang hiam cihleh ka Thukham na nusiat loh nadingun upna-bulkip kong pia ding hi.
Ka pa’ tapa neihsun leh ka nu muhna ah a it-huai naupangno ka hih lai-in,
amah in kei zong hong hilhin, keima kiangah, “Ka kammalte na lungsim ah lenkip in. Ka Thukhamte zui inla, nungta in!
Pilna ngah inla, thu theihtelna zong ngah in! Ka kam pana kammalte panin pial kei inla, mangngilh kei in.
Pilna nusia kei in; amah in nang hong kem ding hi. Amah it in, amah in hong cing ding hi.
Pilna pen awlmawh masak pen ding ahi hi; tua ahih ciangin pilna zong in. Tua ciangin na ngahsa khempeuh tawh thu theihtelna zong in.
Amah thupisak in, amah in nang hong tawisang ding hi. Amah na pom ciangin amah in pahtawina hong puak ding hi.
Amah in na lu tungah kizepna hoih hong sik ding a, nangma tungah minthanna lukhu hong pia ding hi,” hong ci hi.
Ka tapa aw, za inla, ka thugen sang in; tua ciangin na nuntak kumte tampi a pha ding hi.
Pilna lampi nang kong hilh a, lampi mante ah nang kong paipih hi.
Nang na pai ciangin, na lampi siangin lauhuai-na om lo ding hi. Na tai ciangin na tuk kei ding hi.
Thuhilhna lenkip inla, khahsuah kei in; limtakin cing in; bang hang hiam cihleh tua in na nuntakna ahi hi.
Migilote’ lampi ah lut kei inla, siatna lampi tawn kei in.
Tua lampi pelh inla, a tung zong tawn kei in! Pialkhia inla, nangma lampi ah pai in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh migilote in siatna khatpeuh a bawl khit matengun a omkhong thei kei uh hi. Amaute in mi khatpeuh a puksak khit matengun a ihmu kei uh hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute in gitlohna anlum ne uh a, ngongtatna leenggahzu a dawn uh hi.
Ahih hangin thutang mite’ lampi pen sunkim dong a tangpha semsem zingsak khuavak tung tawh kibang hi.
Migilote lampi ahih leh khuamial tawh kibang a, amau a tuksak bang hiam cih zong a thei kei uh hi.
Ka ta aw, ka Thukhamte limtakin ngai inla, ka thugente na bil ngat in.
Na mai panin paikhiasak kei inla, na lungtang laizangah kem in.
Bang hang hiam cihleh tua thute a zong mite aa dingin tuate in nuntakna ngahsak a, pumpi buppi aa dingin cidamna ahi hi.
Kidop theih tawpin na lungsim cing in; bang hang hiam cihleh tua panin nuntakna tuinakte luangkhia hi.
Na kiang panin a man lo thugenna kam lakhia inla, gensiatna mukte na kiang panin gamlapi ah koih in.
Na mitte a mailam tangtakin haksak inla, na mailam tangtakin en gige in.
Na khete’ pai-na mun en gige inla, lampi kipte tung bek sik in.
Taklam ahi a, vei lam ahi zongin pial kei inla, siatna lampi tawn kei in.

headings.text: Zi leh Pasal tunga Cihtakna hanga Phattuamnate

verses.text: Ka tapa aw, ka pilna ngai in. Ka thu theihtelna ah na bil ngat in:
Tua hileh khentel theihna na kisek ding a, na mukte in thuhtheihna a kem ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh numei paktatte’ muk pen khuaizutaak bangin khum a, ama kam pen sathau sangin neel zaw hi.
Ahih hangin a tawpna ah amah pen gamsai bangin kha a, langnih-hiam namsau bangin a hiam hi.
Sihna ah a khete paisuk a, ama kalsuanna in Sheol; hankhuk, tangtakin manawh hi.
Amah in nuntakna lampi ngaihsutin nei lo a, a lampite in manawh mel nei loin kawi a, ahih hangin amah in a thei kei hi.
Tua ahih ciangin ka tate aw, tu-in ka thu hong ngai un; ka thu genna panin pialkhia kei un.
Gamlapi panin tuanu peel unla, a inn kongkhak nai-ah pai kei un;
Tua bang ahih keileh na minphatna uh mi dang tungah tung ding a, hehpihna a neilo mite tungah na nuntakna uh na pia kha ding uh hi.
Tua ciangin na hauhna teng uh tawh khualmite in nuamsa ding a, na thalawhna gahte uh khualmipa’ inn ah tung ding hi.
Tua ciangin na cilesa leh na pumpi kiamgawp-in a tawpna ah na kap ding uh a,
“Bang hangin thuhilhna mudah ing a, bang hangin hong kitai-na leh hong kihilhkholhna ka lungsim in mudah a hi hiam!
Ka siate thu ka mang nuam kei a, kei hong hilh mite thu ka ngai nuam kei kha hi!
Tu-in mihon kikhopna leh mihon laizangah kisiat kiuhkeuhna mong ah ka om ta hi,” na ci ding uh hi.
Nangma tuikuang mah panin dawn inla, nangma tuikhuk panin a phul tui mah in siang hi, ci-in a kigen mah bangin,
Kongzingte-a tui luangkhiate bangin na tuinakte luangkhia zelzul gawp ding ahi hiam?
Tuate nang aa bek hisak inla, mi dangte tawh neikhawm kei in.
Na tuinak in thupha ngah henla, na khangno lai-a na zi tawh nuamsa in.
A it-huai sazukpi ahih keileh a lungkim huai sakhipi bangin a tawntungin ama nawite tawh lungkim in. Ama itna tawh nang hong mancip den hen.
Ka ta aw, bang hangin angkawmnu’ matcipsa-in om na hi hiam? Bang hangin mi dang khat angkawi na hi hiam?
Bang hang hiam cihleh mihing gamtatnate khempeuh siangtakin Yahweh in mu a, a pai-nate khempeuh limtakin a sittel hi.
Migilopa ama gamtat hoih lohna mah ah awk a, ama mawhna khauhualte mah in a gakcip hi.
Ama ki-uk zawh lohna hangin amah si ding a, ama hai luatna tawh a pial gawp ding hi.

headings.text: Yahweh aa dingin a Muhdah-huai Sagih

verses.text: Ka ta aw, na sanggampa sum leitawi na ah a lohzawh kei leh ama tangin lohsak dingin na kiciam leh, ahih keileh khualmi khat kiciamna van khatpeuh a loh zawh kei leh lohsak dingin thukimna-in khut na kilet khak leh,
Na kampau pan-a kammal tawh a awk na hi a, na ciamsa thu bangin hong kiman hi.

Tua ahih ciangin ka ta aw, hih bangin hih in; nang le nang kihonkhia in; bang hang hiam cihleh tu-in na sanggampa khut sungah om na hi hi. Pai-in kiniamkhiat inla, hong khahkhiatna dingin na sanggampa kiangah va thuum in.
Sabengpa khut-a sakhi leh vasa bengpa khut-a vasa bangin na suahtak matengin,
ihmu kei inla, zong lusu kha kei in.
Thadahpa aw, miksi kiangah pai-in, a nuntak ziate ngaihsun inla, pil in.
Amah in a makaih, a lamlak leh a uk zong nei se loin,
khuakhal hunin a nek ding an nei a, anlak hun-in an a kaikhawm hi.
Thadahpa aw, bang tanvei lum ding na hi hiam? Cik ciangin thokhia ding na hi hiam?
Tawmvei lum lai ning, tawmvei mengme lai ning, tomno sung khut tawh kihum-in mengme lai ning na cih sungin,
a buluh gawpte bangin zawnna na tungah hong tungin, galhiam tawi khat bangin hong susia mang ding hi.
Migina lo a gilopa in a kam panin zuau thu genin vak kawikawi hi.
Amah in a mit sinsan-in, a khe tawh gen a, a khutmete tawh hilh hi;
a lungsim sungah zuauthu bek om a, siatna vive geelin ahih keileh ki-etkhialhna vive a piangsak hi.
Tua ahih ciangin thakhat thu-in ama tungah haksat-buaina hong tung vat ding a, tomno sungin bawlkik zawh nawn lohin kisia mang ding hi.
Yahweh in a muhdah guk om hi. Hi hi, Ama aa dingin a kih-huai sagih om hi:
Kiphatsakna, zuaugenna, mawhbang lo sisan suahna,
gitlohna vive ngaihsutna lungsim, siatna lamah manlangna,
zuau genin a manlo tecipangte leh a sanggamte lakah ki-etkhialhna a vawh mi ahi hi.
Ka ta aw, Yahweh’ Thukhamte zui inla, Yahweh’ Inn panin Thukham sung hilhcianna leh lamlahnate nusia kei in.
Na lungsim ah a tawntungin tuate khihcip inla, na ngawng ah tuate ok in.
Na pai ciangin tuate in nang hong makaih ding a, na ihmut ciangin tuate in nang hong cing gige ding hi; na khanlawh ciangin tuate in nang hong hopih ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh thupiaknate pen meivak hi a, Thukham pen khuavak ahi hi; thuhilh-in kitainate pen nuntakna lampi ahi hi:
tuate in numei ginalo kiang pan, khualmi numei’ a zolsiam leii panin nang hong kep nading ahi hi.
Na lungsim sungah ama meel hoihna lunggulh kha kei inla, ama hong zawlmitna khenglah kha kei in.
Numei paktat khat’ manh in anlum khat manh zah hi a, ahih hangin khualmi numei khat’ manh dingin nangmah nuntakna mahmah ahi hi.
Mi khat in a puan kangsak loin mei-am pom thei ding ahi hiam?
Mi khat in a khe kangsak loin, mei-am sa tungah pai thei ding ahi hiam?
A vengpa’ zi tawh a mawh mipa zong tua mah tawh kibang hi—tuanu a mawhpih peuhmah mawhbang lo hilo ding hi.
Mi khat in a gilkial ciangin a gilvah nadingin na a guk ciang nangawn-in, mite in gutapa khahkhong lo uh hi;
Amah a kimat leh, ama inn-a a neihsa khempeuh a bei ding ahi phial zongin a guksate hangin a zah sagih-in a kipiasak hi.
Ahih hangin numei tawh mawhna a bawl mipa pen thu theihtelna nei lo hi a, tua bang a gamta mipa in ama nuntakna mah a susia ahi hi.
Amah in liamna leh mindaina ngah ding a, ama maizumna maimang lo ding hi.
Bang hang hiam cihleh hazatna in a pasal’ hehna khangsak a, amah in a thukkik ciangin tawmcik zong a hehpih kei ding hi.
Amah in liau-sum zong sang nuam lo ding a, letsong tampi na piak hangin zong hehnem zo lo ding hi.
Ka ta aw, ka thute kem inla, ka Thukhamte na sungah khol in.
Ka thupiaknate kem in, na nungta ding hi. Na mit nauta bangin ka Thukham kem in.
Na khutmete tungah hen inla, na lungsim ah tuate gelh in.
Pilna kiangah, “Ka sanggamnu na hi hi!” ci inla, thu theihtelna kiangah, “Ka kinaipihpen ka tanau-numei na hi hi!” ci in.
Tua ciangin amaute in khualmi numeite kiang pan, a kammalte tawh hong zol numei paktatte kiang panin hong kem ding hi.
Ka inn tawlet kongvang panin ka khuadak a,
mimawlte lak, tangvalte lakah thu theihtelna nei lo khangno khat ka mu hi.
Tuanu innkiu nai-a lampi tungah amah pai a, tuanu inn lam manawh-in a pai hi;
Zan vomin a mial ma, nitak a bei kuan, khuamui hun ahi hi.
En in, amah a dawntuah dingin numei paktat khat bangin puan a silh, a lungsim ah a hoih lo ngimna khat a nei numei khat hong paikhia hi.
(Tuanu pen maizum na meel thei loin a hang mahmah hi a, a inn ah a khe a om ngei lo khat ahi hi.
Tu-in kongzing teng leh, tual-awng teng, mun kiu teng ah mi a buk ahi hi.)
Tua ahih ciangin tuanu in amah manin, nam a, maingal takin ama kiangah,
“Tuni-in ka kiciamna tangtun ka hih manin ka inn ah kilemna biakna’ sa ka nei hi.
Tua thu hangin nang tawh kimu dingin a pusuakkhia ka hi hi. Lunglawp takin nang kong zong a, kong mu ta hi.
Egypt pana a mel tuamtuam tawh a kigan puan hoihpen, ka lupna tungah ka phah khin a,
Myrrh, aloes leh cinnamon paknamtui tawh ka lupna ka namtuisak khin hi.
Hong pai in, zingsang dong itna tui dawn khawm ni. Itna tawh nuamsa khawm ni.
Ka pasal inn ah om lo a, khual gamlapi ah zinkhin hi;
Amah in sum ip khat keng a, a kiseh ni a tun mateng inn hong ciah lo ding hi,” a ci hi.

Bang hang hiam cihleh amaute a Tankhiapa vanglian a, note langah amau thu a panpihpa Amah hong hi ding hi.

Thumaan mipa a pa nakpi-in lungdam ding a, tapil a nei mipa a tapa hangin lungdam kipaak ding hi.

verses.text: Hihte pen Yahdah kumpi Hezekyah mite’ teisawn Solomon’ paunak dangte ahi hi.
Yahweh’ minthanna pen Ama ipsim a thu sungah om a hi; ahih hangin kumpite’ minthanna pen a thu muhkhiatna hang ahi hi.
Vantungte sangin leitung a thuk mah bangin kumpite’ lungsim muhkhiat zawh ding ahi kei hi.
Ngun tung panin a ek lakhia lehang, ngunsekpa aa dingin vanzat suak a,
Kumpipa kiang panin migilote hemkhia lehang, ama kumpi-tokhom pen thumaanna tawh kip ding hi.
Kumpipa mai-ah kiliansakin om kei inla, miliante lakah zong munla kei in.

Singkhuah-amlai, thaltang leh sih theihna khatpeuh a lawngawp mi pilvang lo pa tawh kibang hi.
Sing om lohna mun ah meikuang veng a, gensiatna om lohna mun ah kinialna bei hi.
Mei-am a amsak ding meihol leh mei a kuangsak ding sing mah bangin kitotna a piansak dingin a kinialhat mi ahi hi.
Gensiatna kammalte pen liamna tawh kibang a, pumpi sungtawngnung dongah tumsuk hi.
Lungsim gilo napi kam zol daldalte pen cimbeng kizut leibeel tawh kibang hi.
Mi mudahte in a kam uh tawh kineih-khem-in thu gen a, a sunglam ah nang hong lehhek sawm uh hi;
Amah in hoihtakin hong hopih ciangin um kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh a lungsim sungah a kihhuai sagih a om hi.
Ama mi muhdahna pen khemna tawh a seel hangin, ama gitlohna pen mihon buppi mai-ah kilangkhia ding hi.
Mi siahna-in dum a to mi peuhmah, amahmah tua sungah kia ding a, mi a kha ding suangtum a khukte, ama tunga kikhuk kik a tuak ding hi.
Leii zuau in a liamsak mite mudah a, a pumphat mawk kam in siatna tunpih hi.
Zingciang-a na sep ding thu kima-sialh kei in; bang hang hiam cihleh ni khat thu-in a piang thei thu na thei kei hi.
Mi dang khatpeuh in nang hong phat henla, ahih hangin nang le nang kiphat kei in; nang’ muk hi loin mi dang khatpeuh muk hizaw hen.
Suangtum gik a, sehnel vangik ahi hi; ahih hangin tua tenih sangin mihaite’ hehna gikzaw hi.
Hehna pen gam a, lungsona in hong khuhnelh hi; ahih hangin hazatna pen kua in thuakzo ding ahi hiam?
Itna i seelbawl sangin a langtang-a kitaiina hoihzaw hi.
Lawm khat in hong liamsakna pen thumaan hi a, ahih hangin gal khat in hong napna pen khemnapi ahi hi.
A gilvah mi in khuaizu duh nawn lo a, ahih hangin a gilkial mipa in an kha nangawn khum a sa hi.
A inn panin a vakvak mipa pen a bu haih vasa tawh kibang hi.
Sathau namtui leh paknamtui in lung nuamsak a, lawm hoih khat in limtaka hong kuppihna zong tua bang mah ahi hi.
Na lawmte ahi a, na pa’ lawmte ahi zongin nusia kei in; na lungkham hunin na sanggampa’ inn ah hawh kei in. A gamla-a om sanggam khat sangin a nai-a om vengpa hoihzaw hi.
Ka ta aw, pil inla, na lungsim kipaaksak in; tua ciangin zakdah nadingin kei hong kote ka dawng thei ding hi.
Thu ngaihsun theite in a hong tung ding buaina mu-in kibu uh a, ahih hangin mimawlte in phusuakin a thuak uh hi.
Khualmi khat in a leitawi lakna ah mawhpuakla-in a pang mipa a puan la inla, khual numei aa dingin a thukimpih ahih leh, a van-pawngna sung panin la in.
Mi khat in zingsang tungin aw ngaih beba tawh a lawmpa thupha pia-in, amah a phawng leh, a lawmpa in samsiatna-in a sang ding hi.
Theu hun nei loin a zuzu guah pen a phunhat numeite’ dan ahi hi.
Tuanu kham ding hanciamna pen huih a nun loh nadingin khamna tawh kibang a, ahih keileh khut sungah sathau mekcip tawh a kibang hi.
Sik in sik mah hiamsak hi; tua ahih ciangin mi khat in a lawmpa’ thu theihna hiamsak hi.
Theikung a donpa in a gah ne ding a, a ukpa a ngak mi kipahtawi ding hi.
Tui sungah maitang a kilat mah bangin mihing’ lungsim in mihing mah kilangsak hi.
Sheol leh Abaddon in cikmahin phazosak hun nei lo a, mihing’ mit zong tua bang mah ahi hi.
Ngun siansak nadingin sik huantuina beel leh kham aa dingin meikhuk a om mah bangin mihing pen ama ngah phatna tungtawnin kize-et ding hi.
An suk bangin sum sungah a sukna tawh mihai khat na suk hangin ama haina na beisak zo kei ding hi.
Na tuuhonte omzia hoih takin thei inla, na bawnghonte limtakin kem in;
bang hang hiam cihleh hauhna in kipden lo a, kumpi-lukhu zong khang tawntungin lungmuang takin a om thei kei hi—
Lopa keu pen ki-atkhia-in hong selkhia a, mualtunga ankungte a kikaihkhop ciangin,
tuunote in na silh ding uh puan hong sikin, keelte in na lo manh uh pia ding a,
na an ding, na innkuante an ding leh na nasem numeite’ tha om nadingin keelnawi a cingin na nei ding uh hi.
Migilote kuama delh lohpi-in taikek uh a, ahih hangin thumaan mite humpinelkai bangin hang hi.
Gam sungah thupalsatna hangin tua gam in tawmvei sungin a uk ulian tampi nei a, ahih hangin theihtelna leh theihna a nei mi khat tungtawnin tua gam sawtpi ding ding hi.
Mizawngte a nengniam mizawngpa pen an khat zong a siit lo guahpi tawh kibang hi.
Thukham a nusiate in migilote phat uh a, ahih hangin Thukham a zuite ahih leh amaute tawh kilemlo uh hi.
Mi tatsiate in thukhenna tel lo uh a, ahih hangin Yahweh a zong mite in na khempeuh a tel uh hi.
A lungsim kawi mihau khat sangin thutang takin a gamta mizawngpa hoihzaw hi.
Thukham a zui mipa pen ta pil hi a, ahih hangin anhaite tawh a kithuahpa in a pa a maizumsak hi.
A man lo ngahna leh summet a pung lakna tawh a hau semsem mipa in mizawngte a hehpih mipa aa dingin a kholsak ahi hi.
Thukham a ngai nuam lo mipa, ama thungetnate nangawn a kihhuai ahi hi.
Thutang mi khat siatna lam a tawnsak mipa pen ama dum sung mah ah kia ding a, ahih hangin thutang mite in gamh hoih a nei ding hi.
Mihaupa amah le amah pil kisa a, ahih hangin theihtelna a nei mizawngpa in amah a teltheih hi.
Thumaan mite in vangliatna a ngah ciangin lungdamna lianpi om a, migilote a liat ciangin mite kibu uh hi.
A mawhna a imcip mipa thupha kipia lo ding a, ahih hangin tuate pulakin a nusia mipa in hehpihna a ngah ding hi.
Yahweh tungah zaktakna a nei tawntung mipa pen thupha ngah hi a, ahih hangin Ama langah a lungsim a khauhsak mipa pen buaina sungah kia ding hi.
A zawng mite tungah a gilo ukpa pen humpinelkai hawk leh vompi hangsan tawh kibang hi.
Thu theihtelna a nei lo ulianpa zong mi bawlsia lianpi khat hi a, ahih hangin huaihamna a mudah mipa a khansau ding hi.
Sisan suah mipa dum sungah tai ding hi; kuamah in amah kham kei hen.
Thutang takin a gamta peuhpeuh kihonkhia ding hi; ahih hangin a lampi panin a pialkhia mipa thakhatin puk ding hi.
Ama leitang a kho mipa in an tampi nei ding a, ahih hangin sunmang a sansan mipa in zawnna tampi nei ding hi.
A citak mipa in thupha tampi ngah ding a, ahih hangin a hau baih gawp nuam mipa pen mawhbang loin om peuhmah lo ding hi.
Guptuam neihna pen a hoih hilo hi; bang hang hiam cihleh anlum themneng khat nangawn hangin mihing in thupalsat kha thei hi.
A huaiham mipa in a huah nadingin huai mengmeng a, ama tungah zawnna a tun ding lam ngaihsun kha lo hi.
A leii tawh a phatphat mipa sangin thuhilh-in a taii mipa in a nungsang ah pahtawina muzaw ding hi.
A nu, a pa’ neihsa laksakin, “Mawhna hi lo hi!” a ci mi peuhmah pen a susiapa’ kithuahpih ahi hi.
Lungsim kihisak mi in kitotna piangsak a, ahih hangin Yahweh sungah muanna a nei mipa a daupai ding hi.
Ama theihna a suang mipa pen mihai hi a, ahih hangin a pil gamtat mi peuhmah kihonkhia ding hi.
Mizawngte tungah a pia mipa in kisapna cih bang thuakkha lo ding a, ahih hangin a kimuhmawh bawl mipa in samsiatna tampi a ngah ding hi.
Migilote a vangliat ciangin, mite kibu uh a, amaute a manthan ciangin thumaan mite khang hi.
Kihilhhilh napi-in a lungkhuah veve mipa pen bawlphatkik zawh nawn loh-in kisusia pak ding hi.
Thumaan mite in thu a neih ciangin mipite lungdam kipaak a, migilote in gam a uk ciangin mipite thuum uh hi.
Pilna a deih mipa in a pa a lungdamsak hi a, ahih hangin numei kizuakte kikholhpih pa in a hauhna beitumsak hi.
Kumpipa in thutang tawh a gam kipsak a, ahih hangin golhguk a sang mipa in a siasak hi.
A vengpa a pumphat mipa in a khe thang a siah ahi hi.
Thupalsatna in mi tatsiate thangzak bangin man a, ahih hangin thumaan mite in la sa-in nuam a sa uh hi.
Thumaan mite in mizawngte tungah thu khual a, ahih hangin migilote in tua bang thutheihna kin lo uh hi.
Mi simmawhte in khuapi sosak a, ahih hangin mipilte in hehna a vengsak hi.
Mipil khat in mihai khat tawh zum ah thu nei leh, amah hehin kogawp a, kilemna om lo hi.
Sisan suah nuam mite in thutang mite mudah a, ahih hangin thutang mite in ama phattuam nading zong uh hi.
Mihaipa in a lungsim sunga om khempeuh genkhia a, ahih hangin mipil ahih leh kidawm takin om hi.
Gam-uk khat in zuauthu a ngaih leh, a ulian khempeuh migilo suak uh hi.
Mizawngte leh mi nengniamte a kibatna uh hih ahi hi: Yahweh in a nih tuakun muh theih nading mittang guan hi.
Mizawngte tungah dik takin thu a khen kumpipa, a tokhom a kikipsak tawntung ding hi.
Ciangduai leh thuhilhna in pilna guan a, ahih hangin a kikhahkhong ta in a nu maizumsak hi.
Migilote a tam ciangin thupalsatna tam semsem a, ahih hangin thumaan mite in amau pukna mu ding uh hi.
Na tapa puahpha in; amah in lungnopna hong pia ding hi. Hi hi, amah in hong kipaaksak ding hi.
Kamsangte’ mangmuhna om lohna mun ah, mipite kisia a, ahih hangin Thukham a zui mi in thupha ngah ahi hi.
Kama gen bek tawh nasem khat kipuahpha thei lo ding a, amah in a theih hangin mang tuan lo ding hi.
Thu a dawn ciangin a pheng dawndawn mi na mu ngei uh hiam? Ama aa ding sangin mihai khat aa dingin lametna om zaw hi.
A neu tung panin nasem khat limtakin a khoipa in a tawpna ah ta bangin nei ding hi.
A hehbaih mi in kitotna piangsak a, hehluatna in tatkhialhna piangsak hi.
Mihing pen a kiphatsakna in amah niamkoih ding a, ahih hangin a lungsim kiniamkhiat mi kilamto ding hi.
Guta khat a pawlpihpa in ama nuntakna mah a mudah hi a, amah in a kipulak Thukham sunga samsiatna za napi-in a mawhna a pulak kei hi.
Mihing’ kihtakna in thangzak bek tun a, ahih hangin Yahweh sungah muanna a nei mipa muanhuai takin a om ding hi.
Mi tampi in gam-ukpa’ maipha zong uh a, ahih hangin mite aa dingin thutanna pen Yahweh kiang bek panin hong pai ahi hi.
Thutang mite aa dingin a thutang lo mipa pen a kihhuai hi a, a gamtatna ah a citak mipa pen migilote aa dingin a kihhuai ahi hi.

headings.text: Vot’ Thuumna leh ‘Pha ta’ a Ci Ngei Lo Na Lite
A Neu Mahmah Ganhing Pil Lite

verses.text: Massa-a Yakeh’ tapa Agur kammalte ahi hi. Hih mipa in Ithiel—Ithiel tung leh Ucal tungah a gen ahi hi:
Mihingte’ ngaihsut siamna nei lo ka hih manin mi khatpeuh sangin bangmah ka thei keizaw hi.
Pilna ka sin ngei kei a, Siangtho Pa’ thutheihna zong ka nei kei hi.

Vantung ah kua kahto a, tuaksuk ahi hiam? Kua in a khut sungah huihte lomcip ahi hiam? Kua in a puantual tawh tuite tuncip ahi hiam? Kua in leitung mongte khempeuh kipsak ahi hiam? Ama Min bang hi a, a tapa min bang ahi hiam? Na theih leh hong gen in!
Yahweh’ kammal peuhmah a siangtho hi. Amah a muang mite aa dingin kidalna lum ahi hi.
Ama kammalte behlap kei un; tua bang hi keileh Amah in note hong thuhilh ding a, na zuau lam hong kimu ding hi.
Keimah in Nang kiangah thu nih kong ngen hi (Ka sihma-in hong nial kei in):
Keima kiang panin kiphatsakna leh zuauna hong hepkhiatsak inla, zawnna ahi a, hauhna ahi zongin hong pia kei in; ahih hangin ka khamkhop zah ding an tawh hong vak in;
Tua bang hi keileh keimah hau-in Nang hong nialin, ‘Yahweh kua hiam?’ ka ci kha ding hi. Ahih keileh keimah zawng leng guta-in ka Pa Yahweh’ Min kong daisak kha ding hi.
A pu kiangah a nasempa gensia kei in; tua bang hi keileh amah in nang hong samsia kha ding a, na mawhna na thuak ding hi.
A pa uh samsia-in a nu a phat lo khanggui khat om hi.
Amau leh amau siang kisa-in, ahih hangin amau nitna panin a kisilkhia lo khanggui khat om hi.
Kiliansak mahmahin a kiphasak khanggui khat om hi.
Leitung panin mizawngte leh mite lak panin micimawhte a nek tum nadingin a ha-te namsau tawh a kibang, a khaguhte temta tawh a kibang khanggui khat om hi.
‘Hong pia in! Hong pia in!’ ci-in a kiko vot in tanu nih nei hi. Kham hun a nei lo na thum om a, ‘Pha ta,’ a ci ngei lo li om hi.
Hankhuk, a ciing naubu, tui a deih tawntung leitang leh ‘Pha ta,’ a ci ngei lo meikuang!
A pa simmawh-in a nu’ thu a mang nuam lo mite’ mittang va-ak in khelkhiasakin, musanete in a ne ding uh hi.
Lamdang ka sak luat thu thum om hi; hi hi, ka tel loh li om hi:
Huih lakah muvanlai a lentoh theihna zia; suangtum tungah gul a pai theihna zia; tuipi laizangah tembaw a laam theihna zia; leh nungak leh tangval kingaihna zia.
Hih in numei paktatnu zia ahi hi: Amah in ne-in, a kam a nul khit ciangin amah in, “A hoih lo bangmah ka gamta kei hi!” a ci hi.
Leitung a liingsak na thum om a, a kithuak zo lo li ahi hi:
Sila khat in a uk ciang; mihai khat in a duh bangbang a nek zawh ciang;
a muhdahhuai numei in pasal a neih ciang; sila numei in a nasepna-pi a luahkhiat ciang.
Leitung ah a neu mahmah ganhing li om a, ahih hangin tuate nakpi takin pil hi:
Miksite pen nam neu mahmah khat ahi uh hi, tua hi napi-in amaute in khuakhal nisat hunin a an ding uh khol zo uh hi.
Suangheng-a teng zupite pen a thahat lo ganhing hon hi a, tua hi napi-in amaute in suang sungah a inn ding a bawl uh hi.
Kauphete in kumpi nei lo uh hi; tua hi napi-in a kituak diamdiamin a honhonin gamta uh hi;
Maimom a khutin bawmin kumpi-inn sungah kimu hi.
Hihte pen a pai uh ciangin a thupitsuah thumte ahi hi, hi hi, a kalsuan dan tawh a kilawm li om hi:
gamsate lakah a thahat, bangmah a kihta lo humpinelkai;
A kihihsak pai aklui; a khangham keeltal; kuamah in a langdo ngam loh kumpipa.
Nangmah hai gamtat kha-in, na kiliatsak leh, ahih keileh siatna na hilh khit leh, na khut tawh na kam hum in.
Bawngnawi dat toktok lehang a thaukhal suaksak a, nak nuai-na in sisan suaksak hi; tua mah bangin hehluatna in kitotna piangsak hi.
Kumpipa Lemuyl tungah a nu in a hilh kamsanna thute:
Ka tapa bang ahi hiam? Ka gil sung pana ka tapa bang ahi hiam? Ka kiciamna’ tapa bang ahi hiam?
Na thahatna numei tungah zang kei inla, kumpite a susia nuampa tungah na thatang pia kei in.
Leenggahzu dawn ding pen kumpite aa ding kilawm lo hi; Lemuyl aw, kumpite dawn ding hi lo hi; gam-ukte in zukhuah dawn huai lo hi;
Tua bang hi keileh amaute in dawn-in, Thukham mangngilh kha ding uh a, mi genthei khatpeuh’ thukhenna a lumlet kha ding hi.
A si dekdek mite tungah kham theihzu pia inla, lungkham mahmah mite tungah leenggahzu pia in.
Siatna a gamta mipa in Thukham nusia a, amah in mizawngte leh mi gentheite phawk nawn lo hi.
Sihna a thuak dingin a kiseh mite’ thu neihna ah, a gen thei lo mite aa dingin gensak in.
Na kam kaak inla, thumaan takin thukhen in; mizawngte leh micimawhte’ thu panpih in.
Kua in zi hoih mu zo ding ahi hiam? Amah pen suangmanpha sante sangin manphazaw tham hi.
A pasal’ lungsim in amah muang mahmah a, a muanna zahin a lungkimna a ngah hi.
Amah in a pasal limbawl ding a, a nuntak sung tawntungin siatna a tun kei ding hi.
Amah in samul leh anthul khau zongin, lawp takin na a sem hi.
Amah pen sumbawl tembawte tawh kibang a, a gamla panin nek leh dawn hong pua hi.
Amah khuamial laipi mahin tho a, a innkuanpihte tungah an pia-in, a nasem numeite’ sep ding a vaihawmsak hi.
Amah in lo hoih zongin lei a, a thalawhsa sum tawh leenggui lo khat a bawl hi.
Amah le amah kithapia-in, a khutte a khauhsak hi.
Amah in a sumbawlna pen a hoihpente lakah a kihel lam mu a, a khuaimei zanin a mit kei hi.
Amah in khau kheekin, puan a gan hi.
Amah in mizawngte huai-in micimawhte a zam hi.
A innkuan khempeuh puansan guanzo ahih manin vuk a kiat hangin a innkuanpihte aa dingin a lunghimawh kei hi.
Amah in a delhphah-tuam dingin puan hoih bawl a, a paun pen naikhau-puan a dupsan ahi hi.
A pasal kitheikim a, gam sung upate lakah thukhen dingin a tut ciangin kongpi ah a pasal kizahtak hi.
Amah in saihadial puan hoihte bawlin a zuak hi; sumbukte ah a meetin kawnggakte a puak hi.
A puansilh pen hatna leh pahtawina hi a, hong tung ding hun ah amah lungdam-kipaak ding hi.
Amah in pilna tawh thu gen a, a leii tungah hehpihna Thukham a om hi.
Amah in a innkuanpihte’ vai vaan a, omkhongna an a ne kei hi.
A tate tho-in, thupha ngahnu a ci uh hi; a pasal zong tho-in, amah a phat hi.
Tanu tampite in hoih takin sem a, ahih hangin nang in amaute khempeuh sangin a hoihzaw-in na sem hi.
Hehpihna pen zuau hi thei a, meelhoihna pen a mawknapi hi thei hi; ahih hangin Yahweh a zahtak numei kiphat ding hi.
1 Ama thalawhsa thaman pia unla, ama nasepte mahmah in kongpi ah phat uh hen.
